        scope[Path] = path + [arg]
        try:
            if op == '.':
                cur = getattr(cur, arg)
            elif op == '[':
                if type(arg) is tuple:
                    cur = cur[arg]
                else:

            elif op == 'P':

        raise TypeError('glom() got unexpected keyword arguments: %r' % sorted(kwargs.keys()))

def chain_child(scope):
    return scope.new_child({
        T: scope[T],
        Spec: scope[Spec],
        UP: scope,
        CHILD_ERRORS: [],
        MODE: scope[MODE],
        MIN_MODE: scope[MIN_MODE],
    })
